info.title: Fall Guardian Backend API
info.description: Device API for Fall Guardian alert delivery. Register once to obtain a device bearer token, then authenticate all fall-alert and caregiver-link calls with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

200.description: Fall alerts for linked protected persons, with `acknowledgedAt`, `acknowledgedByMe` and `acknowledgementCount`.

401.description: Missing or invalid device bearer token.

get.description: Returns alerts from protected persons linked to the authenticated caregiver device, including acknowledgement state. `acknowledged` and `acknowledgedByMe` are true when the authenticated caregiver acknowledged the alert; `acknowledgedAt` is the first acknowledgement time by any linked caregiver (ISO-8601 UTC; omitted, like other null fields, while nobody acknowledged); `acknowledgementCount` is the number of caregivers who acknowledged it. Status may move from `failed` or `partially_sent` back to `dispatching` while the server retries delivery.

422.description: Only a caregiver device can register a notification token.

401.description: Missing or invalid device bearer token.

post.description: Stores the Firebase Cloud Messaging token used to deliver fall notifications to the authenticated caregiver device.

requestBody.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token for this caregiver device. Fall-alert pushes carry `data` keys: `type` (`fall_alert`), `alertId`, `fallTimestamp`, `cancelDeadlineAt` (ISO-8601 UTC), `reminder` (`0` for the first notification, `1` for re-notifications while the alert stays unacknowledged), optional `latitude`/`longitude`, and optional `protectedPersonName` (this caregiver's name for the protected person). A token rejected by Firebase as unregistered or invalid is deleted server-side; register it again after refreshing it.

401.description: Missing or invalid device bearer token.

404.description: No fall alert with that identifier was found, or the caregiver is not linked to its protected person.

post.description: Records that the authenticated caregiver has seen an alert belonging to a linked protected person.

post.summary: Report receipt of a fall alert
post.description: Records that a linked caregiver device received a dispatched fall alert. Repeated receipts are idempotent.

get.description: Returns active protected-person links for the authenticated caregiver device.

delete.description: Revokes one link owned by the authenticated caregiver. The protected person and their other caregiver links are unchanged.

422.description: Only a protected-person device can create an invitation.

401.description: Missing or invalid device bearer token.

post.description: Creates a short-lived invitation code on a protected-person device. Share the code with the caregiver who will accept the link.

422.description: Only a caregiver device can accept an invitation.

401.description: Missing or invalid device bearer token.

404.description: The invitation code was not found, expired, or was already used.

429.description: Too many invitation acceptance requests from this client.

post.description: Links the authenticated caregiver device to the protected person associated with this valid invitation code.

post.summary: Exchange a one-time enrollment token for companion credentials
post.description: Exchange a one-time enrollment token for companion credentials

201.description: Device registered. The response includes the bearer token to store securely.

429.description: Too many device registration requests from this client.

post.description: Registers an app installation and returns the bearer token required by subsequent API calls. Store that token securely on the device.

requestBody.description: Application installation and device role to register.

post.description: Revokes the authenticated device or another protected-person device belonging to the same protected person.

201.description: Fall alert accepted. Non-cancelled alerts are queued for caregiver delivery.

401.description: Missing or invalid device bearer token.

403.description: A caregiver device cannot report a protected-person fall.

429.description: Too many fall alert submissions from this client.

post.description: Reports a fall detected for the authenticated protected-person device. Use a stable clientAlertId to identify this alert across retries and later cancellation.

requestBody.description: Detected fall event and optional location. Set `cancelled` to true when the protected person stopped the alert before caregiver notification; the fall is stored for caregiver history without urgent push dispatch.

401.description: Missing or invalid device bearer token.

403.description: A caregiver device cannot cancel a protected-person fall.

404.description: No fall alert with that clientAlertId was found for the authenticated device.

post.description: Cancels a previously reported fall by its clientAlertId. Only the protected-person device that reported the alert may cancel it.

post.summary: Attach a location fix to an already-reported fall alert
post.description: Updates the latitude/longitude of a fall alert once a GPS fix resolves. Reporting the alert must not block on this — it is submitted separately, best-effort. Only the protected-person device that reported the alert may attach a location.

404.description: No fall alert with that identifier was found for the authenticated device.

401.description: Missing or invalid device bearer token.

get.description: Returns the current lifecycle status of an alert reported by the authenticated protected-person device.
Returns active caregiver links for the authenticated protected-person device.
